title: This Bear Blocks Everyone Without Moving 🐻🏀😂
description:
He moved. Everyone panic. 🐻🏀 Bruno the bear guards the hoop without moving a muscle. A squirrel, a raccoon and a fox all try to get past him. Nobody does.

Kapi in the League, Episode 3: Bruno's Wall. A 3D animated basketball comedy about a very calm capybara, a very big bear (Bruno) and a very fast rabbit (Bunny), with Rico the parrot on the mic.

▶️ Start from Episode 1, Season Opener: https://www.youtube.com/shorts/ULDSAqNZm8g
👉 Next episode: Rico Loses It. Subscribe to Kapi's World so you don't miss it!
💬 Who would you rather play against: Bruno the wall or Bunny the speedster? Tell us in the comments!

Made with AI-assisted animation tools. The characters and the story are original.

#Capybara #Basketball #FunnyAnimals #Shorts #Animation #KapiInTheLeague
